{{Quote|We are battle droids no longer. Now we are slaves.|This droid to R2-D2|<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>}}
This '''unidentified junk droid''' was stationed on the snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] and used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] terrorist organization, the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], as target practice.

==Biography==
Some time during its history, this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was captured by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] terrorist organization and brought to their [[Death Watch camp|encampment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]], where, along with other captured droids, was used as target practice for the Death Watch soldiers and had most of its components removed and replaced.

When junior [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] arrived on Carlac along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to deliver a [[Holotrace device/Legends|holotrace device]] with the location of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to the the Death Watch, R2 was ordered by the soldiers to fix all of the damaged droids, including this one, to be used as target practice again.

After the Death Watch attacked the [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] [[Ming Po town|town]] and Ahsoka's true identity was revealed, she along with Lux were brought back to the camp and faced execution. Fortunately, R2-D2 had finished repairing the droids and had assembled them to fight against the Death Watch, allowing Ahsoka and Lux time to escape. In the end, after the [[Battle on Carlac/Legends|firefight]] broke out, all of the droids were destroyed, but Lux, Ahsoka and R2-D2 managed to escape the camp and subsequently, the planet.

==Behind the scenes==
This droid was composed of different droid body parts, including a [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] head, a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] torso, arms of a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-Series Tactical droid]] and legs from a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]].
